verdict.rationale: CDP documents its own conversion capability: deposit destinations can act as liquidation addresses that auto-convert incoming funds (e.g., USDC to USD), and onramp/offramp move value between fiat and crypto. But there is no evidence of a standalone conversion/quote API with executable quotes, and the upfront fee quotes are documented for transfers, not conversions. missing for 10: explicit conversion quote and execute endpoints, documented conversion rates/spreads and fees, settlement-time documentation, stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion in the payments API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, conversion is a first-class API — quotes and executed conversions between fiat and stablecoins (and between stablecoins) with documented rates, fees, and settlement times

citations.quote: A destination can also act as a liquidation address, automatically converting incoming funds into a different asset before crediting the account.
Accept customer USDC, auto-convert it to USD, and collect it in your treasury, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
Coinbase Onramp and Offramp enable seamless movement of value between fiat and crypto in both directions.
